purpose: Canonical machine-readable handoff for the genetic TTF program. It states exactly which data surfaces may be opened next and prevents a failed or incomplete qualification from being interpreted as biological evidence.

development_panel.dataset: Decker et al. bird/bat development geometry

within_species_self_detectability.scope: within-species self-detectability only; does not authorize Decker outcome opening

forbidden: open Decker Monmonier results or break labels
round the A3 Wilson upper bound down to the 0.10 ceiling
retune graph, bandwidth, alpha, null family, species panel, or split from the failed Gate-D result

fresh_confirmatory_route.dataset: fresh phylogatR download independent of the Decker development files

phase_1.allowed_input_surface: genes.txt, cite.txt, current-schema occurrences.txt, aligned FASTA headers only
phase_1.taxonomic_firewall: Animalia excluding Aves, Chiroptera, and the exact frozen 221-species Decker exclusion set

phase_2.allowed_input_surface: canonical-valid versus noncanonical character masks only
phase_2.species_rule: every frozen edge must have at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair
phase_2.split_rule: inherit the Phase-1 train/evaluation assignment and filter only; no resplitting

phase_3.action: repeat the full dataset-specific profiled-private genetic Gate-D on the exact Phase-2 survivor geometry

phase_4.action_if_and_only_if_phase_3_passes: unmask nucleotide identity and compute the predeclared p-distance response on the already-frozen edges

interpretation_contract.qualified_cross_species_positive: evidence for a transferable place component of within-species genetic differentiation
interpretation_contract.qualified_cross_species_negative_with_se: evidence consistent with lineage-conditioned spatial structure within the tested domain

next_authorized_action: Obtain a genuinely fresh phylogatR archive and execute response-blind Phase 1 only. Do not open nucleotide identities.
